## D — Accuracy notes and source flags: occupant protection, vehicle condition and starting the car
Every C and C2 fact cites exactly one physical manual page from the selected range; nothing relies on outside knowledge.
The child passenger rule for the youngest children is printed with the words under age two and those weighing under the weight limit, which can be read as either condition or both; the dossier repeats the manual's own wording and adds no stricter reading [A03] (verify NJ-BELT-D-UNDERTWO).
The air bag lives-saved statistic credited to the federal safety agency is a dated figure, not a rule, so it was left out of the fact blocks [A04].
The blind-spot diagram on the starting page is an image whose labels did not extract as values; no fact relies on it [A10].
Statute citations printed after each rule were summarized, not copied; fines, phone numbers and websites are isolated as dynamic.

corpus_stability.reason: The New Jersey Driver Manual prints 2026 on its front cover and a single back-cover code; the identification charts carry one revision note (Revised 4/2026) and the manual says fees are subject to change, with no sign of more than one rewrite per year in the selected pages.

verification_debt.claim_text: The child passenger safety summary (physical page 44) says children under age two and those who weigh less than the stated weight must ride rear-facing; it is unclear whether either condition alone triggers the rule; confirm against N.J.S.A. 39:3-76.2a.
